insight: An Indian vibe-coding startup that raised ~$100M and was valued at $300M in early 2026 after a fast climb to eight-figure ARR.
name: Emergent
tagline: Chat with AI agents that design, code, test, and deploy your app.
description: Emergent is a vibe-coding platform that turns a conversation into a production-ready app — a coordinated team of AI agents designs, builds, tests, and deploys full-stack web and mobile applications from natural-language prompts. It targets small businesses and non-developers shipping software without a codebase.

modelSupport.notes: Orchestrates multiple AI agents; frontier models under the hood.

edge: Coordinates a team of specialized agents to design, code, test, and deploy in one flow — aimed at non-technical founders, not just developers.
pros: Full app from a natural-language chat
Agents handle design, code, test, and deploy
cons: Credits can run out on complex builds

references.title: Emergent triples valuation to $300M with $70M fundraise
